status: fixed before numerical-study results were inspected
observational_data: none; no FORCE arrays or holdout reads
seed_policy: identical seed, options, timestep count and generated bed definitions across grids; compare physical-plan fingerprints
budget_units: m2 of sediment grains, equivalent to m3 per metre out of section
budget_tolerance: 1e-6 m2 + 1e-10 times the affected inventory scale, per component and per bed, per event
budget_policy: count physical sources/sinks and each open face independently; retain raw residuals; never renormalize or label unaccounted interior loss a boundary flux
horizons: same unit and profile x in all grids; unique contiguous complete intervals only; all rejected/absent/fragmented/boundary intervals retained with reason
field_metrics: slowness-integrated vertical travel time on common 0-3000 m support; sea-floor depth; matched fault depth at fixed x
classification: report 40-20 and 20-10 differences, ratio, same-sample coverage and monotonic/oscillatory/noncontracting counts; 10 m is not truth; no accuracy pass claimed
